jobs.title: Distribution Center General Manager of Operations
jobs.description:
We are a Parts Store and SO much more and we are looking for even more great talent to join our NAPA family! Our NAPA Brand is known around the world for having KNOW HOW and now we are looking for a talent who has the KNOW HOW to drive operational excellence of a Distribution Center and serve as a NAPA General Manager of Operations!

Position Mission:
Lead and direct the facility's management team within a fast-paced distribution environment, focusing on safety, leadership, operational excellence, self-motivation, problem-solving and teamwork. This leader will establish route maps with clear objectives and drive a sense of urgency to ensure that operational plans are executed, performance and budget goals are achieved, and teams are kept informed and coordinated across functions. You will foster a “safety first” culture through awareness, training and accountability. You will quickly establish yourself as an engaging and inclusive leader with ownership for the team’s ability to maximize its productivity, growth and development. You’ll create a positive work environment though real-time observations and specific, constructive, and actionable feedback. You’ll have the autonomy to innovate with new approaches to process and methods, all in the name of more efficiency and implementing future process flow optimization. Your ability to find root causes to problems will be well supported by an environment of calculated risk and testing. You’ll leverage a mix of metrics, Lean principles, Six Sigma, and other activities to understand and fine-tune the operation. Your commitment to others will shine when you jump right in to help teams meet their business goals.

Position Performance Measures:
- Building Safety & Compliance
- Quality
- Customer Service Levels & On-time Delivery
- Meeting/Exceeding P&L and Budget Goals
- Operational Effectiveness
- Employee Engagement, Retention & Team Culture

Responsibilities:

The following section contains the primary responsibilities for this position.  Job holder is responsible for performing any other duties as assigned by management.
- Hires, trains, develops, motivates, and supports the distribution center salaried and hourly teams
- Develops and monitors production plans for the DC and ensures that the optimal level of staffing is being allocated to the available work.
- Manages associates keeping those safe work practices as first priority, making sure they are followed to support a safe work environment
- Oversees the DC’s P&L and works with salaried managers to maximize productivity and deliver budgeted targets.
- Establishes sound process improvement initiatives that drive year over year improvement, as well as streamline and optimize day-to-day operations.
- Partners with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to identify and lead DC network projects that contribute to total logistics cost and operational effectiveness.
- Collaborates with other operational and support leaders in the network to drive standardization of processes, share ideas and support one another in their implementations
- Supports operational strategy and innovation to drive business goals for revenue, operational performance (e.g., safety, quality, service, cost), and profitability
- Develops leaders to be capable of coaching, counseling, and motivating associates to attain optimum safety standards, customer service, productivity levels, and associate engagement
- Ensures communication and teamwork among staff to aid in the accomplishment of the department objectives
- Ensures that all company and HR policies and practices are communicated to department associates and practiced consistently
- Monitors operational policies and procedures to ensure the most efficient and effective processing of delivery orders; control of damages, errors and mis-picks; and excellence in customer service levels
- Helps develop and maintain inventory/security controls to prevent shrinkage and shortages
- Ensures effective communications; up, down and across the business
- Manages multiple priorities in a face-paced environment with effective communication and thorough follow through

Leadership Expectations
- Culture Champion - Models our GPC values to foster our culture; holds oneself and others accountable; and supports our commitment to communities, social justice, corporate social responsibility, and sustainability; maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics, and compliance.
- Servant Leadership - Acts as an altruistic servant leader and is consistently humble, self-aware, honest, and transparent.
- Curiosity & Courage - Demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; fosters an environment that supports learning, innovation, and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.
- Digital Transformation & Change - Seeks and implements continuous improvements and encourages the team to leverage new digital tools and ways of working.
- Deliver for the Customer - Customer Focus - Delivers expected business results while putting the customer first and consistently applying an operational excellent mindset.
- Strategic Thinking - Adopts a holistic perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans and shaping the team’s strategy.
- Focus on our Employees - Diversity, Equity & Inclusion - Identifies, attracts, and retains diverse and inclusive team members; builds a high-performing team; embraces diversity in all its forms; and actively supports diversity goal programs.
- Collaboration & Influence - Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively and cross-functionally to achieve objectives; and communicates with energy and positivity to motivate, influence, and inspire commitment and action.
- Talent Management - Creates a discipline and focus around developing talent, promotes an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work, empowers employees and partners to act in the best interest of the customer and company, and regularly recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.

Experience, Education, and Abilities:
- Four-year degree or equivalent experience·5 years’ experience handling inventory/operational tasks·5 years' management experience in a Distribution Center / Fulfillment Center environment
- Demonstrated leadership ability, with the ability to engage and motivate others
- Excellent communication, interpersonal and organizational skills
- Good reasoning, conflict-management, and analytical and problem-solving skills
- Experience with activity-based performance metrics, process improvement, and Lean thinking with a track record of delivering ‘best in class’ operations and performance
- Great communication skills and the ability and desire to manage a team
- A working knowledge of OSHA and DOT regulations
- A willingness to learn and being able to go above and beyond is a must
- Willingness to relocate for future growth opportunities, a bonus

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

In our fast-paced Distribution Centers, you’ll always be on the move. Please note the following physical requirements in addition to tasks above:
- Must be able to see, hear, speak, and write clearly in order to communicate with employees and/or customers/vendors.
- Must be able to bend, twist, stretch, push, pull carry and lift up to 60 lbs.
- Should be comfortable standing and or walking for up to 12 hours
- Able to operate powered industrial equipment including walkies, reach truck, stand ups – proper training and safety standards will be provided
- Occasionally exposed to cold, hot and/or humid conditions; moving mechanical parts and vibration.
- The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
- Constant awareness of moving vehicles like forklifts, pallet jacks, etc.
- Position operates in a warehouse setting with continuous exposure to industrial noise (e.g., forklifts, conveyors, machinery, and loading activities), bright overhead lighting, and varying temperatures due to limited climate control.
- Employees regularly work around moving equipment and mechanical operations and must remain alert to audible and visual safety signals in a fast-paced environment.

This is the right opportunity for you if you:
- Love the hustle – Our Distribution Centers are busy, yet fun places!
- Be a solution focused leader and able to pivot when changes are needed!
- Are operationally focused, but care about Employee Engagement and Talent Development
- Have a constant eye on Sales and Profit Quota
- Want to join a team where you can learn and grow your career – the opportunities are endless at NAPA!

What you’ll need:
- HS Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred or comparable experience in a Service Manager or Distribution Center/Warehouse Manager role.
- Experience managing and improving operational P&L performance in the area of distribution management and logistics.
- Organizational skills, with the demonstrated ability to multi-task.
- Ability to make decisions using strong analytical and problem solving skills.
- Ability to use computer systems effectively to analyze and drive asset protection and business development.
- Ability to build teams, manage conflicts, develop personnel to assume higher levels of responsibility. The ability and willingness to delegate.
- Unquestioned values, judgment and integrity.

What’s in it for you:
- Awesome people and brand
- Competitive Pay
- Outstanding health benefits and 401K
- Stable company. Fortune 200 with a “family” feel
- A Culture of promotion from within, using your creativity, finding solutions/fixes, and where no 2 days or career paths are the same!
- Great training, and ongoing development with support from multiple leaders/your team

If this role sounds like a fit, please take the time to complete our super quick and easy application. We are excited and humbled that you are considering NAPA as hopefully your future employer.

We offer a competitive starting salary range of $112,000 for this position. Please note that total compensation may vary based on individual skills, experience, and qualifications. We believe in rewarding our employees fairly and encourage candidates to discuss their unique backgrounds during the interview process.

Benefits:
Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans.
Retirement Plan: 401(k) with company match.
Paid Time Off: Vacation, personal days, holidays, sick days, and paternal leave
Additional Perks: Employee stock purchase plan, tuition reimbursement, professional development opportunities, and wellness programs.

jobs.title: Director, HR Operational Excellence - Global Industrial
jobs.description:
Job Summary
The Director, HR Operational Excellence is responsible for leading the governance, performance management, continuous improvement, analytics, knowledge management, and project delivery functions within HR Operations. Working in partnership with the Directors of HR Operations Service Delivery and People Systems, this role enables the execution of the HR Operations strategy by establishing operational standards, improving processes, advancing data-driven decision making, and ensuring consistent application of policies, procedures, controls, and service delivery practices across the organization.

Reporting to the Senior Director, HR Operations, the Director partners closely with HR Operations Service Delivery, People Systems, Payroll, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, business leaders, and external partners to improve organizational effectiveness, increase operational efficiency, strengthen governance, and enhance the employee experience.

This leader is responsible for establishing and sustaining an operational excellence culture focused on continuous improvement, knowledge management, analytics, project execution, compliance, and operational performance. The role plays a critical leadership function in supporting both Day 1 operational stability and the future modernization of HR Operations through process improvement, automation, self-service, and AI-enabled capabilities.

Responsibilities

HR Operations Strategy & Governance
· Partner with the Senior Director, HR Operations and peer leaders to execute the HR Operations strategy, operating model, and priorities.
· Lead the Operational Excellence function, including Knowledge & Policy Management, Process Excellence, and Reporting & Analytics.
· Drive operational consistency through adoption of established policies, standards, controls, and governance practices.
· Monitor organizational performance and identify opportunities to improve service delivery, operational effectiveness, employee experience, and productivity.
· Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve operational performance, reduce risk, and strengthen organizational capabilities.
· Establish and facilitate operational review processes that promote accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement across HR Operations.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
· Build and maintain a culture of continuous improvement across HR Operations.
· Lead process redesign, harmonization, standardization, and optimization initiatives.
· Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through process improvement, workflow automation, self-service enablement, and technology adoption.
· Implement methodologies that improve operational effectiveness, productivity, quality, and scalability.
· Establish operational maturity and service delivery improvement roadmaps.
· Ensure operational excellence efforts remain aligned to business priorities and organizational objectives.

Knowledge Management & Policy Governance
· Provide executive oversight for organizational knowledge management and policy governance programs.
· Ensure policies, procedures, service catalogs, standard operating procedures, and knowledge articles are maintained and continuously improved.
· Establish governance processes that promote consistency and reduce operational risk.
· Ensure employees, managers, and HR teams have access to accurate, current, and actionable knowledge resources.

Reporting, Analytics & Workforce Insights
· Lead the development of workforce analytics, operational reporting, and business intelligence capabilities that enable data-driven decision making across HR and the broader organization.
· Develop and maintain executive dashboards, scorecards, and performance metrics that provide visibility into workforce trends, employee experience, organizational health, compliance, and service delivery performance.
· Translate workforce and operational data into actionable insights that influence workforce planning, talent decisions, organizational effectiveness, and business outcomes.
· Ensure reporting integrity, data quality, and governance while identifying opportunities to leverage advanced analytics, predictive insights, and emerging technologies to improve organizational performance.

Compliance, Risk & Controls
· Establish and maintain operational controls that support compliance with company policies and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
· Partner with HR, Legal, Payroll, Internal Audit, and business leaders to address compliance risks and control gaps.
· Lead operational audits, control reviews, and risk assessments.
· Ensure key compliance activities are documented, monitored, and reviewed on a regular basis.
· Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, and operational discipline.

Technology Enablement & Digital Transformation
· Partner with People Systems leadership to identify opportunities for technology-enabled improvements.
· Support optimization of Workday, ServiceNow, reporting platforms, automation tools, and employee self-service capabilities.
· Prioritize operational requirements and business needs that drive system enhancements and digital transformation efforts.
· Support the adoption of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled service delivery capabilities .

Qualifications
· Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Analytics, or related field.
· 12+ years of progressive experience in HR Operations, Shared Services, Operational Excellence, Process Improvement, Consulting, or related disciplines.
· 7+ years of leadership experience managing managers and operational teams.
· Demonstrated experience leading transformation, process improvement, governance, reporting, analytics, or operational excellence initiatives.
· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic planning capabilities.
· Experience establishing operational performance metrics and governance frameworks.
· Proven ability to influence and collaborate across multiple organizational functions.
· Experience managing complex projects and organizational change initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications
· Experience supporting U.S., Canadian, and Mexican HR Operations environments.
· Experience within industrial distribution, manufacturing, logistics, or other operationally intensive industries.
· Experience building or transforming HR Shared Services or HR Operations organizations.
· Experience with Workday, ServiceNow, workflow automation, reporting platforms, and employee service delivery technologies.
· Lean Six Sigma, PMP, Change Management, SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or similar certifications.
· Master's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
· Experience supporting organizational separations, integrations, or large-scale business transformations.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Work is performed in an office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment.

COMPANY INFORMATION:
Motion offers an excellent benefits package which includes options for healthcare coverage, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, vacation, sick, and holiday pay.

DISCLAIMER:
This job description illustrates the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this job classification. It is not intended to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and skills required. Management retains the right to add or modify duties at any time.

jobs.title: Director, Financial Planning & Analysis -Global Industrial
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Director of Financial Planning & Analysis leads the enterprise-wide planning, forecasting, and financial analysis processes, providing strategic decision support to executive leadership. This role   is responsible for   driving financial planning excellence,   optimizing   resource allocation, enhancing forecasting accuracy, and delivering actionable insights that support business performance and shareholder value creation. The position partners closely with Corporate and Business Unit leadership,   FPA Business   Unit   leadership,     Investor Relations,   Financial Reporting ,   Accounting, Strategy, and Operations to ensure alignment of financial   objectives   and business priorities.

Responsibilities :

- Lead the global Forecast, Annual Operating Plan, and Long-Range Planning processes, driving coordination across business units and corporate functions while continuously improving forecasting accuracy and efficiency.

- Partner with executive leadership, corporate functions, and regional business units to provide value-added financial insights, identify risks and opportunities, and support strategic decision-making.

- Drive enterprise-wide standardization and continuous improvement of financial planning processes, systems, reporting, and governance to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and scalability.

- Lead economic and market intelligence activities,   leveraging   internal and external data sources, macroeconomic indicators, industry trends, customer demand signals, inflation forecasts, and third-party market research to develop enterprise growth assumptions, support forecasting accuracy, and   provide   strategic insights to executive leadership.

- Support capital allocation decisions through financial analysis, investment evaluation, scenario modeling, and prioritization of strategic initiatives.

- Lead   global   monthly financial reviews, including variance analysis against forecasts and budgets, identification of key business drivers, and communication of actionable recommendations.

- Develop and maintain sophisticated financial models to support forecasting, strategic planning, capital investments, acquisitions, and other business initiatives.

- Support Investor Relations activities, including preparation of earnings materials, investor presentations, financial messaging, and analysis supporting external communications.

- Support quarterly external reporting processes, including earnings releases, earnings call preparation, presentation materials, and executive briefing documents.

- Partner with executive leadership to develop Board of Directors materials and presentations, providing financial analysis, strategic insights, and performance reporting.

- Assist   in the development and preparation of a monthly   consolidated   corporate reporting package, including   consolidated   financial statements and detailed analysis of key performance indicators.

- L ead, develop, and mentor FP&A team members, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

- Oversee planning and reporting system enhancements, financial models, and reporting tools in partnership with IT and Finance Systems teams.

- Ensure the quality, integrity, timeliness, and accuracy of financial forecasts, reporting, and analyses while maintaining strong governance and internal controls.

- Perform special projects, strategic analyses, and other duties as assigned by senior leadership.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or Accounting

- 10 + years of relevant experience in Accounting or Finance

- Minimum of   4   years in finance leadership role developing high-performing talent and directing high-performing team(s)

- Strategic mindset and proven ability to successfully lead a finance team

- Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, tracking, and reporting operating expenses

- Experience developing complex financial modeling skills, analytical skills, including a detailed understanding of financial statements and cash flow information

- Demonstrated analytical and quantitative ability, have a high degree of intellectual curiosity with   a track record   of delivered results while achieving or exceeding deadline expectations

- Ability to develop structured and fact-based strategy reports that include succinct conclusions and recommendations

- Proven problem solving, leadership and interpersonal skills,   maintain   sound judgment when making decisions and be highly organized

- Proven   track record   to deliver   high levels   of customer service

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, be a quick learner with the ability to learn multiple systems and various data outputs,   consolidating   information into meaningful analysis to help drive both financial and operational decisions

- Outstanding Microsoft sk ills with a focus on Excel and PowerPoint

- E ducation , experience,   and/or   technical skill   requirements .

Leadership

- Embodies the following values: serve, perform, influence, respect, innovate, team.

- Effectively communicates by motivating and inspiring others through clear and proactive

- Delivers results and drives customer success by committing and focusing on outcomes to deliver results and making the customer the center of decisions.

- Makes balanced decisions and thinks strategically by being a forward thinker.

- Develops high-performing teams by providing inclusive leadership,   attracting   and developing world-class talent, providing ongoing feedback and building trust across the organization.

Physical Demands / Working Environment

- Principal duties of this job are performed primarily in an office environment, with occasional field duties.

- Prolonged   periods   sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

- Must be able to stand and walk short distances between work sites.

- Must be able to work in a corporate office setting.

jobs.title: Inbound Operations Manager Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Job Summary
The Inbound Operations Manager is an energetic leader that oversees strategic implementation of inbound operations for their respective distribution center location. Reporting to the General Manager or Assistant General Manager, this role ensures all inbound teams, operations and activities are managed properly and adhere to safety and compliance regulations. The Inbound Operations Manager ultimately ensures that strategic priorities for inbound operations are implemented throughout all inbound activities, while also promoting a culture of engagement, empowerment and problem-solving amongst all teammates.
Responsibilities
- Collaborates with General Manager and/or Assistant General Manager in implementing operational strategies to optimize efficiency and productivity.
- Manages functions of inbound operations by setting strategic performance expectations, monitoring productivity of all inbound teams and troubleshooting as needed.
- Leads strategic implementation of inbound operations, ensuring efficient organization of inbound freight (scheduling and unloading), receiving dock, stocking activities, housekeeping, maintenance, and safety protocols are consistently upheld.
- Bolsters strategies for adherence to all safety rules and regulations to ensure a safe environment for employees.
- Trains and develops employees to ensure teams function at the highest level of efficiency, filling in any areas as needed.
- Ensures supplier, delivery partner and/or customer inquiries and concerns are managed in a timely and professional manner, while encouraging team members to take ownership of customer issues and find creative solutions to meet customer needs; resolves escalations as needed and/or escalates further as appropriate.
- Works cross-functionally with other DC management to monitor for and investigate and resolve repetitive patterns of receiving errors.
- Protects company assets ensuring all equipment is used and maintained properly, buildings are opened, checked and secured daily, monitoring employees so no merchandise leaves without proper receipts.
- Maintains awareness of budget planning and cost management efforts and implements cost-saving initiatives and process improvements.

Qualifications
- 2+ years’ experience within a distribution center or similar environment.
- 1+ year’s proven experience in a managerial role and/or leading teams.
- Ability to motivate and inspire a team to actively contribute to problem-solving and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities, with a keen attention to detail and a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
- Familiarity with warehouse operations and logistics software (e.g., WMS, ERP systems).
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
- Commitment to upholding high standards of integrity, professionalism and customer service, with a focus on supporting team members and delivering for customers.

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in business administration, logistics, or a related field.
- 3+ years’ experience within a distribution center or similar environment.
- 2+ year’s proven experience in a managerial role and/or leading teams.
- Proven experience performing various quality functions (inspection, control, assurance, audits).
- Lean six sigma and project management skills.
- Expertise in leveraging relevant tools and technology (including MS Office, Promapp, Power BI, Visio, etc.).
- Customer-centric spirit and task-execution.
- Enthusiasm for data, analysis, and providing simple insights.

jobs.title: Building Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary
The Building Operations Manager provides strategic and operational leadership for workplace services across the corporate campus and assigned facilities. This role establishes service standards, leads and develops workplace operations teams, manages key vendor partnerships and operating budgets, and drives continuous improvement in employee experience, space utilization, service delivery, and operational readiness. The position serves as a trusted partner to business leaders in aligning facilities operations with evolving business needs.

Responsibilities
- Manage the day-to-day workplace operations across assigned corporate facilities, including direct oversight of reception services, building services operations, and workplace support staff.
- Oversee front desk operations and visitor management to ensure a professional, welcoming experience for employees, candidates, guests, and vendors.
- Manage access-control processes, including employee badge administration, to maintain a secure workplace environment.
- Manage workplace systems and records, including office assignments, seating charts, occupancy data, conference room scheduling platforms, and space utilization information.
- Coordinate office moves, workstation setups, furniture installations, departmental relocations, and workspace readiness activities in partnership with Human Resources, IT, and business leaders.
- Establish service-level standards, key performance indicators, and reporting for reception, mailroom, conference center, building services, and vendor-delivered services.
- Drive continuous-improvement initiatives that enhance service quality, operational efficiency, cost effectiveness, and employee experience.
- Develop and maintain operating procedures, service standards, escalation protocols, and governance processes for workplace operations.
- Manage mailroom and print services operations, including shipping and receiving, package distribution, courier services, mail processing, and multifunction device support.
- Manage workplace service requests and ensure timely resolution of operational, facility, and employee service issues.
- Conduct routine facility inspections to identify operational, appearance, safety, maintenance, and service concerns.
- Manage third-party vendor relationships and contracted services, including  landscaping,  moving services, locksmiths, pest control, and general building maintenance, while monitoring service quality, contract compliance, and performance expectations.
- Plan and execute facility projects, office renovations, space reconfigurations, workplace improvements, and operational initiatives.
- Develop and manage operating budgets; approve invoices within delegated authority; identify cost-saving opportunities;  monitor operating expenses, and maintain operational documentation and inventory records.
- Perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications
- High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor's Degree in Facilities Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Hospitality Management, or a related field preferred.
- 7+ years of facilities operations, workplace services, office operations, property management, hospitality management, or related experience.
- 3+ years of leading teams, vendors, or multi-function operations.
- Experience leading employee-facing service functions, including workplace services, reception, mailroom, conference center, hospitality, or facilities support operations.
- Experience managing vendor relationships, service contracts, and operational service delivery.
- Experience establishing KPIs, service-level agreements, and performance-reporting processes.
- Experience leading change initiative, workplace projects or service transformations across multiple stakeholder groups.
- Strong leadership, customer service, coaching, and team development skills.
- Strong organizational, project management, and problem-solving abilities with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build effective partnerships across all levels of the organization.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, workplace management technologies, access control systems, or similar operational platforms.
- Valid driver's license.

Preferred Qualifications
- Certified Facility Manager (CFM), Facilities Management Professional (FMP), or other related industry certification.
- Experience supporting multi-building corporate campuses.
- Experience with workplace reservation platforms, access control systems, and space planning tools.
- Experience managing facilities operating budgets.
- Experience supporting executive events, large employee meetings, and workplace programs.
- Knowledge of workplace ergonomics, occupancy planning, and corporate space utilization practices.

Leadership
- Embodies the following values: serve, perform, influence, respect, innovate, team.
- Effectively communicates by motivating and inspiring others through clear and proactive communication.
- Anticipates operational risks and changing workplace needs; develops proactive, scalable solutions.
- Makes sound financial, operational and customer-focused decisions using data and business judgment.
- Creates an inclusive, high-accountability environment that develops talent and recognizes strong performance.

Physical Demands / Working Environment
- While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be required to walk long distances to cover the property portfolio.
- The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds.
- Frequently required to stand, walk, bend, stoop, kneel, reach, climb stairs, and move throughout multiple buildings and campus locations.
- Must be able to move, assemble, position, and reconfigure office furniture, conference room equipment, workplace materials, and event-related assets.
- May be required to load, unload, transport, and distribute furniture, equipment, office supplies, packages, and other workplace materials.
- Must possess the ability to inspect facilities, identify operational issues, and safely access various areas of company facilities.
- Ability to safely operate hand tools and workplace support equipment as necessary.
- Must be able to work in both office and field environments throughout the campus.
- Regular use of computers, mobile devices, printers, and office technology equipment.
- May occasionally work outdoors while supporting campus operations, inspections, deliveries, or events.
- May occasionally be required to work evenings, weekends, or outside normal business hours to support special events, facility emergencies, operational requirements, or business continuity activities.
- Ability to operate company-owned vehicles, vans, carts, or similar transportation equipment as needed.

Communicates monthly wholesale strategies and tactics to the Sales Pros, assigning goals and holding the sellers accountable. This role is responsible for building high performing teams and ensuring NAPAs vision, values, and culture exceed expectations for employees, customers, and key stakeholders to drive NAPA’s profitability.

- Major Account, Fleet and Government program sales
- All aspects of customer connectivity: NAPA PROLink, TRACS, etc.
- Lead NAPA AutoTech Training Classes
- Identify IBS prospects

- Ensures HQ directed sales programs and initiatives are executed at a high level to drive growth and profitability.
- Leads, motivates, and mentors Sales Pro team to implement effective sales strategies to achieve revenue targets and market share growth across all locations.

- Analyzes market trends to identify opportunities for gross margin expansion and ongoing pricing maintenance. Collaborates with operation leadership in preparing business cases for investment at store level.
- Track sales metrics and KPIs, preparing reports and presentations for senior management to communicate progress and identify areas for improvement.
- Manage Sales Pro team prospecting of new accounts and/or fostering growth of underperformers. Ensures proper registration of all assigned accounts in RAM.

- Build and maintain relationships with effective communication with store teams, customers, and executive leadership thru collaboration and influence to achieve success through others.
- Evaluates sales results of region and district stores to ensure the delivery of strategic objectives within budget. Collaborates with others to produce accurate and achievable sales projections for the district.
- Accountable for recruitment and selection of sales team members while ensuring appropriate support for stores in assigned territory. Key role in succession planning.
- Motivates high performing sales teams to achieve sales quota thru coaching, feedback, and meaningful developmental. Conducts regular district sales meetings, encourages continual learning, and ensures completion of all company required training.
- Partners with store leadership to identify and deploy strategies and tools to improve store efficiency and service levels to achieve and exceed district financial objectives and quotas.
- Oversee unmanageable debt collections and ensure expenses to remain within established budgets.
- Build and maintain relationships with effective communication with store teams, customers, and executive leadership thru collaboration and influence to achieve success through others.
- Demonstrates sound decision-making ensuring adherence to company values and policies; requires and models high levels of professionalism of self and teams.
- Ensures team maintains a safe and healthy environment for customers and employees. Complies with all applicable policies, rules, and regulations, including those relating to safety, health, labor, and employment.

- Utilizes NAPA CRM Tools to monitor leads, log customer interactions and schedule sales calls.

- Sales Quota attainment.
- Gross Margin/Profit Expansion and Quota attainment.
- Execution of company sales programs and initiatives.
- Sales Team averages ten presentations a day.
- AutoCare Center Sales and membership growth.
- Major Account Sales Growth.
- Fleet and Government Sales Growth.
- IBS Growth
- Bad Debt %.

- High school diploma and 2+ years’ work experience leading a sales team.
- In depth understanding of and mastery of basic selling skills such as preparing for the sales call, managing the customer meeting, handling customer resistance, closing the sale, and account maintenance.

jobs.title: Vice President Total Rewards  - Global Industrial
jobs.description:
SUMMARY
The Vice President, Total Rewards is a strategic enterprise leader responsible for shaping and advancing the organization’s total rewards strategy in support of business performance, talent strategy, and long-term growth. This role leads the design and execution of compensation, benefits, executive compensation, recognition, and broader rewards programs that attract, motivate, retain, and engage a high-performing workforce.
Working closely with the Chief People Officer, executive leadership, and the Board of Directors, the VP of Total Rewards brings a strong understanding of the intersection between people, performance, and economics. The role translates business priorities into reward strategies that are competitive in the market, differentiated where it matters, financially disciplined, and meaningful to employees.
This leader will also play a critical role in evolving the Total Rewards function as the organization changes—ensuring programs, governance, technology, and processes are scalable, data-driven, and aligned with the needs of a complex global enterprise.

JOB DUTIES
·       Develops and leads an integrated global Total Rewards strategy aligned with the company’s business strategy, talent priorities, culture, and financial objectives.
·       Establishes a clear rewards philosophy that balances market competitiveness, internal equity, pay-for-performance, affordability, and employee experience.
·       Serves as a trusted advisor to the CHRO and executive leadership on significant compensation and benefits decisions and emerging rewards trends.
·       Regularly assesses the effectiveness of the rewards portfolio and recommends changes based on business needs, workforce insights, market movement, and financial considerations.
·       Leads the strategy and governance for executive compensation, including annual and long-term incentive programs, executive pay positioning, and related governance requirements.
·       Partners with the CHRO, CEO, Board, and Compensation Committee on executive compensation matters, including preparation of materials, recommendations, and market analysis.
·       Oversees the design and administration of broad-based compensation programs, including salary structures, annual incentive plans, sales incentives, recognition programs, and other performance-based rewards.
·       Strengthens the connection between individual and organizational performance and compensation outcomes.
·       Ensures compensation programs support attraction and retention of critical talent while maintaining appropriate cost discipline.
·       Provides strategic leadership for the company’s global benefits portfolio, balancing employee needs, competitiveness, financial sustainability, and risk.
·       Oversees health, retirement, wellbeing, leave, and other benefit programs across applicable geographies.
·       Continuously evaluates the benefits portfolio to ensure it reflects changing workforce expectations and provides meaningful value to employees.
·       Partners with Finance, Legal, Risk, and external advisors to manage benefit costs, compliance, vendor relationships, and plan governance.
·       Establishes consistent global rewards principles while allowing appropriate flexibility for local market and regulatory requirements.
·       Uses workforce data, external benchmarks, and business intelligence to identify opportunities to improve rewards effectiveness.
·       Partners with HR Business Partners and business leaders on complex talent, organizational, and workforce decisions where compensation and rewards are a critical component.
·       Supports major organizational changes, restructurings, acquisitions, divestitures, and other strategic transactions through compensation and benefits analysis and planning.
·       Modernizes the Total Rewards function through effective use of technology, analytics, automation, and emerging AI capabilities.
·       Builds stronger rewards insights through data and predictive analytics, enabling leaders to understand the relationship between compensation, performance, retention, talent risk, and cost.
·       Identifies opportunities to simplify processes and improve the employee and manager experience through technology and automation.
·       Establishes meaningful metrics and dashboards that allow senior leaders to understand the impact and return of Total Rewards investments.
·       Maintains strong governance over compensation and benefit programs, policies, practices, and decision-making.
·       Ensures programs comply with applicable legal, regulatory, tax, accounting, and governance requirements.
·       Partners closely with Legal, Finance, Internal Audit, Payroll, HR Operations, and other stakeholders to manage risk and maintain appropriate controls.
·       Establishes clear decision rights and governance mechanisms for significant rewards decisions.
·       Leads, develops, and retains a high-performing Total Rewards organization with the expertise and capabilities required to support a complex enterprise.
·       Establishes clear priorities, accountability, and operating rhythms across the Total Rewards team.
·       Builds strong partnerships across HR and the broader enterprise, particularly with Finance, Legal, Payroll, HR Operations, and business leadership.
·       Elevates the Total Rewards function from a program administrator to a strategic business partner.
·       Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE
Typically requires a bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline. A master’s degree is preferred, along with fifteen (15) years of progressive experience in Total Rewards, Compensation & Benefits, or related HR leadership roles.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES
·       Significant experience leading enterprise-level compensation and benefits strategies within a complex, matrixed organization.
·       Demonstrated experience with executive compensation and Board/Compensation Committee engagement.
·       Strong understanding of broad-based compensation, incentive design, benefits, retirement programs, and rewards governance.
·       Experience leading global or multi-market rewards programs preferred.
·       Demonstrated ability to translate complex data and market information into clear business recommendations.
·       Experience leading organizational transformation, M&A, divestitures, restructurings, or other significant business change preferred.
·       Strong financial acumen and understanding of the cost implications of rewards decisions.
·       Demonstrated experience building and leading high-performing teams.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
LICENSES & CERTIFICATIONS:
SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY: 2-5 Direct Reports
BUDGET RESPONSIBILITY : Yes

COMPANY INFORMATION:
Motion offers an excellent benefits package which includes options for healthcare coverage, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, vacation, sick, and holiday pay.

jobs.title: Retirement Benefits Manager - Global Industrial
jobs.description:
SUMMARY:
The Retirement Benefits Manager serves as the lead subject matter expert for the Company's retirement, and financial wellness plans and programs. This individual contributor role is responsible for the strategy, administration, compliance, governance, vendor management, and continuous monitoring of retirement programs, including qualified and nonqualified defined contribution plans, nonqualified deferred compensation plans, plans, and financial wellness initiatives within the U.S and Canada.  This role also supports retirement plan governance activities, including the research, analysis, and preparation of retirement plan appeal recommendations for Committee review and determination.
The Retirement Benefits Manager partners closely with Human Resources Shared Services, Finance, Payroll, Legal, external consultants, recordkeepers, and trustees, to ensure retirement programs remain competitive, compliant, cost-effective, and aligned with the Company's Total Rewards strategy and employee financial well-being objectives.

JOB DUTIES
- Serve as the primary subject matter expert for all retirement benefit plans and programs, including qualified and nonqualified retirement plans, ensuring effective administration, compliance and employee support.

jobs.title: Learning and Development Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary
The Learning and Development Manager serves as a strategic learning partner within NAPA’s centralized Learning & Development team, directly supporting one or more designated business units. This role plays a critical part in enabling business success by equipping leaders and team members with the knowledge, skills, and clarity they need to perform with confidence and grow within the organization.
As a trusted support partner to business leaders, the Manager identifies capability gaps and translates strategic priorities into meaningful learning experiences that drive performance and operational excellence. This individual leads the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of impactful learning solutions, managing the full lifecycle of programs and content to ensure relevance, quality, and measurable impact.
Blending instructional design expertise, facilitation excellence, program leadership, and data-informed decision-making, the Manager creates opportunities for learning that strengthen capability, foster engagement, and support individual growth. Through strong partnerships and a deep understanding of business needs, this role ensures learning initiatives are aligned with strategy and contribute directly to both organizational success and the development of NAPA’s people.
Responsibilities
Strategic Business Partnership
- Partner with business unit leaders to assess performance gaps and translate strategic priorities into targeted learning solutions.
- Conduct comprehensive needs analysis, including stakeholder interviews, data review, and performance metrics assessment.
- Measure and assess the impact of training and program effectiveness to ensure achievement of objectives and alignment with business priorities.
- Develop clear learning objectives aligned with business outcomes and KPI expectations.
- Serve as a trusted support partner to leaders and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).

Learning Design & Development
- Apply adult learning theory and established instructional design models (e.g., ADDIE or similar frameworks).
- Lead and coordinate end-to-end design and development of learning programs related to job skills and role competency development.
- Develop blended learning solutions (ILT, virtual, eLearning, microlearning, job aids).
- Incorporate learner feedback and program evaluation data to continuously improve offerings.

Program & Project Leadership
- Lead multiple learning initiatives simultaneously with advanced project management discipline.
- Manage learning calendars and end to end program logistics (before, during after event).
- End to end management of all projects and programs.
- Ensure quality assurance across programs, materials, and delivery standards.

Facilitation & Delivery Excellence
- Deliver engaging instructor-led and virtual training experiences.
- Demonstrate strong classroom management and learner engagement techniques.
- Build assessment tools aligned to learning objectives.

Learning Systems & Administration
- Administer and manage learning programs within a LMS.
- Maintain accurate training records and compliance documentation.
- Monitor attendance and completion rates.
- Generate actionable reports tied to team KPIs.

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Education, Business, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
- 5+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, Instructional Design, or Talent Development.
- Demonstrated expertise in adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies.
- Experience managing full lifecycle learning programs in a high collaboration environment.
- Strong facilitation experience (in-person and virtual).
- Experience administering and reporting from a Learning Management System (Workday preferred).
- Proficiency in eLearning development tools and content authoring platforms.
- Experience with reporting, analytics, and data-driven program evaluation.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Digital Category Management
jobs.description:
Company Background:
Established in 1928, Genuine Parts Company is a leading global service provider of automotive and industrial replacement parts and value-added solutions. Our Automotive Parts Group operates across the U.S., Canada, Mexico, Australasia, France, the U.K., Ireland, Germany, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, Spain and Portugal, while our Industrial Parts Group serves customers in the U.S., Canada, Mexico and Australasia. We keep the world moving with a vast network of over 10,700 locations spanning 17 countries supported by more than 63,000 teammates. Learn more at genpt.com .

Position Purpose:
Reporting to the Director of B2B Digital Operations & Experience, this role is a critical leadership position responsible for shaping and scaling digital category performance across NAPA’s multi-billion-dollar B2B eCommerce business.

We are seeking a Sr. Manager, Digital Category Management to lead a high-impact team and drive measurable growth through best-in-class omni-channel merchandising, category strategy, and customer experience optimization across 6,000+ locations and thousands of customers in the U.S. and Canada.
This role requires a strategic, but hands-on builder and operator- a proven leader who can develop high-performing teams, influence across a complex organization, and deliver sustained financial results at scale.
Responsibilities:
What You Own
- Omni-Channel, digital first, category performance across assigned categories

- End-to-end digital merchandising strategy (search, browse, taxonomy, product content)

- In collaboration with functional partners, omni-channel merchandising strategy (availability, delivery promise, pricing & promotions, post order experience, account management, etc.)

- Conversion rate, traffic growth, and digital revenue expansion

- Scalable playbooks for category growth and operational excellence

- Leadership and development of a multi-layered team

Team Leadership
- Lead, scale, and evolve a multi-functional team of Digital Category Managers and Operations Leads

- Build a high-performance culture with clear accountability, strong coaching, and succession planning

- Develop future leaders and create a deep leadership bench

- Establish operating rhythms, performance standards, and decision frameworks

Category Performance & Financial Stewardship
- Own digital revenue performance, forecasting, and goal attainment across assigned categories

- Drive improvements in conversion, traffic, average order value, and attach rates

- Define and execute category growth strategies using data-driven insights

- Partner with merchandising, inventory, and product teams to align, prioritize and drive omnichannel strategies that drive increased sales, & digital adoption

Category Management & Omni-Channel Experience Leadership
- Define and champion best-in-class omni-channel merchandising offering & experience

- Set the strategy for how categories show up online - assortment, placement, content, discoverability, availability, delivery promise, post-purchase experience

- Lead category business reviews and growth planning with clear KPIs and accountability

- Identify and unlock opportunities through omni-channel analytics, customer behavior, and performance data

- Own and drive improvements in the category experience roadmaps, with operational oversight for:
- Onsite merchandising

- Search & navigation

- Product content & data quality

- Identify systemic barriers (process, data, tooling) and drive cross-functional solutions

Stakeholder Communication
- Deliver clear, concise executive-level narratives grounded in data

- Influence senior stakeholders to align on priorities, investments, and outcomes

- Translate complex performance data into clear, actionable insights

Location :
- GPC has two work locations to choose from, Duluth or Atlanta office.

- We offer a Flexible Work Policy that permits eligible employees to work a hybrid remote schedule.

Desired Qualifications & Experiences:
- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, technology, or equivalent experience.

- 10+ years of experience in eCommerce, digital and omni-channel merchandising, or category management

- Experience in B2B or multi-channel retail or B2B environments strongly preferred

- Proven track record of driving online revenue growth at scale

- Deep expertise in digital merchandising, including search, navigation, taxonomy, and product content optimization

- Experience leading and developing high-performing teams in a complex organization

- Strong analytical mindset with experience leveraging data to drive decisions

- Ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels

- Exceptional stakeholder management and influence skills

Job Title: Indirect Purchasing Manager

Reporting To: Product Operations Director

Department: Product Operations / Procurement

Role Purpose

The Indirect Purchasing Manager will lead the development and management of the group’s indirect procurement function. The role is responsible for establishing sourcing strategies, supplier-management practices, purchasing controls, and processes for goods and services not intended for resale.

The role will deliver value, cost efficiency, supply continuity, governance, and service improvements while partnering with stakeholders across the group.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and implement the indirect purchasing strategy, policies, processes, and controls.

- Lead sourcing activities for indirect goods and services, including tendering, quotation, evaluation, negotiation, and supplier selection.

- Manage indirect spend categories and develop category plans aligned with operational and business requirements.

- Negotiate and manage supplier contracts, commercial terms, pricing, service-level agreements, and renewal arrangements.

- Establish supplier performance-management processes, including performance reviews, risk management, issue resolution, and corrective actions.

- Identify and deliver cost-saving, value-improvement, standardisation, and spend-consolidation opportunities.

- Build effective partnerships with budget holders and stakeholders to understand demand, requirements, and future purchasing needs.

- Oversee purchasing activity, purchase-order compliance, delegated authority controls, and procurement governance.

- Lead, coach, and support indirect purchasing team members, including the Indirect Purchasing Buyer where applicable.

- Develop procurement reporting, including spend analysis, savings tracking, supplier performance, contract status, and compliance measures.

- Ensure procurement records, supplier information, contracts, and documentation are accurate and maintained appropriately.

- Work with Finance and operational teams to support budgeting, forecasting, payment terms, and cash-flow objectives.

- Identify and mitigate supply, commercial, operational, and supplier-related risks.

- Drive continuous improvement in procurement systems, processes, data quality, and stakeholder service.

Key Stakeholders

- Product Operations Director

- Finance and budget holders

- Operations, Facilities, IT, HR, Marketing, and other support functions
- Senior business leaders

- External suppliers, service providers, and contract partners

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

Essential

- Significant experience in procurement, purchasing, category management, or supply chain.

- Experience leading indirect procurement activity and managing a range of indirect spend categories.

- Proven ability to lead sourcing events and negotiate supplier contracts and commercial terms.

- Strong understanding of procurement governance, supplier management, contract management, and purchasing controls.

- Demonstrable track record of delivering cost savings, commercial value, or operational improvements.

- Experience managing stakeholders at different levels, including senior leaders.

- Strong analytical, financial, negotiation, planning, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to lead, develop, and motivate team members.

- Strong proficiency with procurement systems, reporting tools, and spreadsheet analysis.

Desirable

- Experience establishing a new procurement function, framework, or operating model.

- Relevant procurement qualification, such as CIPS, or equivalent experience.

- Experience in a multi-site, distribution, retail, automotive, or operational business.

- Experience using e-procurement, contract-management, or supplier-performance systems.

Key Competencies

- Strategic and commercially focused

- Strong negotiator and influencer

- Leadership and people-development capability

- Collaborative stakeholder partner

- Analytical, organised, and detail oriented

- Decisive, pragmatic, and solutions focused

- High standards of integrity, governance, and accountability

- Continuous-improvement mindset

Measures of Success

- Delivery of agreed cost savings, cost avoidance, and value-improvement targets.

- Increased visibility, control, and compliance across indirect spend.

- Improved supplier performance, service quality, and contract outcomes.

- Reduced supplier risk and strengthened continuity of supply.

- Timely completion of sourcing activity, contract renewals, and purchasing requirements.

- Stakeholder satisfaction with procurement support and commercial outcomes.
- Effective development and performance of the indirect purchasing team.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Procurement & Cost Management
jobs.description:
Job Overview
The Senior Manager of Cost Management will lead and oversee NAPA's strategic efforts to optimize cost of goods sold (COGS) across the product portfolio. This role is responsible for developing and leveraging advanced cost models, performing variance analysis, and monitoring global costs to manage product cost inflation and deflation. The position will spearhead cost reduction initiatives via supplier negotiations, detailed cost validations, and cross-functional collaboration with Category Management, Engineering, Sourcing and Pricing teams. As a strategic leader, this role will identify value enhancement opportunities and drive continuous cost improvement across global supply chains in alignment with business objectives.

Key Responsibilities
Cost Management
- Lead end‑to‑end cost management of multi‑billion‑dollar procurement from a diversified, multi‑tier global supplier network
- Identify opportunities for cost optimization and lead cross-functional teams to consistently achieve year-over-year value capture.
- Lead complex, high-stakes data driven supplier negotiations to secure the lowest total acquisition cost without compromising operational requirements.
- Develop and implement advanced tools and processes to improve cost analysis, reporting accuracy, and stakeholder communications.

Cost Modeling
- Lead the creation and maintenance of detailed cost models to analyze and forecast product cost changes.
- Collaborate closely with engineering teams during product teardown and shouldcost modeling to understand cost drivers and enhance model precision.

Negotiation Strategy and Supplier Engagement
- Develop and execute comprehensive negotiation strategies to secure optimal terms and cost structures with global suppliers.
- Lead high-stakes supplier negotiations, leveraging market insights and cost analysis to drive cost savings without compromising quality or service.
- Partner with sourcing and category teams to align negotiation approaches with overall procurement and business objectives.

Tenders & Sourcing Strategy
- Partner with Category and Sourcing teams to refine sourcing strategies by leveraging global cost insights.
- Work cross-functionally to capture comprehensive total cost of ownership data to establish accurate baselines for procurement initiatives.
- Provide expert guidance and mentorship within the organization on best practices related to cost management.

Budget and Initiative Management
- Lead the development of yearly budgets focused on cost-out targets, aligning financial goals with strategic cost management plans.
- Oversee and drive cost reduction initiatives throughout the year to achieve budget objectives, monitoring progress and adjusting actions as necessary.
- Collaborate with finance and cross-functional teams to track budget performance and report on variances and outcomes.

Leadership Responsibilities and Traits
- Lead, manage, and develop a dedicated team of cost management professionals, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous professional growth.
- Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide constructive feedback, and support career development plans for direct reports.
- Demonstrate ownership and accountability for cost management results, actively driving key initiatives with minimal oversight.
- Exhibit strategic thinking to anticipate risks and opportunities in global costs and supply chains, enabling proactive decision-making.
- Coach and develop team members by sharing knowledge, encouraging continuous learning, and promoting a culture of high performance.
- Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership by delivering insightful cost analyses and actionable recommendations.
- Manage multiple priorities effectively, balancing short-term tactical needs with long-term strategic objectives.
- Lead and influence cross-functional teams by fostering collaboration, clear communication, and alignment toward common cost reduction goals.

Required Qualifications and Experience
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
- Minimum 7+ years of progressive experience in cost management, procurement, global sourcing, manufacturing cost estimation, or product cost analysis.
- Extensive experience (5+ years) in supplier contract negotiation and cost control initiatives at a global scale.
- Strong financial acumen and proficiency in advanced Excel modeling and data analysis tools.
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multi-million-dollar cost reduction projects.
- Experience with global commodity markets, indices, and sourcing strategies is highly desirable.
- Solid understanding of manufacturing processes, supply chain dynamics, and product cost drivers.
- Excellent communication, organizational, and project management skills.

Preferred Attributes
- Automotive industry experience is desired.
- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
- Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
- Proactive leadership style with a focus on collaboration and driving measurable results.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

jobs.title: Category Manager Industrial Hose & Connectors Asia Pacific
jobs.description:
We are seeking a dynamic and commercially driven Category Manager – Industrial Hose & Connectors (APAC) to lead strategy, growth, and profitability across this critical product category.

In this leadership role, you will hold overall responsibility for the Industrial Hose and Connectors portfolio, including:
- Development and execution of the category strategy
- Delivery of sales and profitability targets
- Supplier selection and strategic management
- Growth of our PBL (Home Brand) range
- Internal technical support and training development

This role operates within a matrixed structure and leads a team of product category specialists.

Key Responsibilities:
Strategy & Commercial Performance
- Lead and deliver the Industrial Hose & Connectors product strategy
- Drive achievement of sales, margin, and growth targets
- Partner with sales teams to optimise pricing and profitability
- Contribute to GMROI, ROIC, and overall inventory performance

Supplier & Product Management
- Develop collaborative partnerships with key suppliers
- Evaluate and recommend new vendors
- Manage agency agreements and supplier relationships
- Ensure technical documentation and master data accuracy
- Champion new products, services, and channels

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Lead and develop your team, including KPIs and performance management
- Provide technical and sales support to the network
- Work closely with Supply Chain, Marketing, Sales Leaders, and Corporate Support
- Engage with key customers and industry stakeholders

About You
Qualifications & Experience:
- Formal qualification in Business and/or Marketing (desirable)
- Strong commercial acumen and demonstrated marketing experience
- Deep segment experience (mechanical aptitude advantageous)
- Leadership and management capability

Skills:
- Strong written and verbal communication
- Excellent organisation and ability to manage multiple priorities
- Collaborative mindset with high customer focus
- Intermediate MS Office skills (Excel, Word, Teams, Outlook, PowerPoint)

Motion is a leader in the distribution of industrial products. We operate across Australia, New Zealand, Indonesia, and Singapore and part of a larger group GPC where opportunities are endless for a motivated individual.

We focus on continuous improvement and sustainable growth as our two main objectives. This is driven by our long-term investment in people, systems, process, and new growth opportunities for our people.

Lead growth and market position for Motion’s Pumps & Seals portfolio across APAC through commercial, technical and supplier partnership leadership.

- Market aligned remuneration + bonuses + annual salary review!

- Lead market growth across Australia, New Zealand and Asia Pacific, partnering with some of the world's leading pumps and sealing manufacturers.

About us
Motion delivers specialised industrial products, technical expertise and customer-focused support to help businesses keep their operations running efficiently. We work with industries such as manufacturing, mining, food and beverage, transport, utilities and other industrial operations.

About the role

Motion is seeking an experienced and commercially astute Category Manager – Pumps & Seals to lead the strategic direction and performance of our Pumps & Seals portfolio across Asia Pacific.

Reporting to the General Manager Fluid Power Products Asia Pacific, this role combines category leadership, supplier management, technical expertise and commercial execution. You will be accountable for delivering category growth through strategic planning, supplier partnerships, range optimisation, pricing initiatives and market development.

Working closely with sales, engineering, supply chain and marketing teams, you will play a key role in expanding Motion's market presence and strengthening our position as a leading industrial products distributor across the region.

This is a rare opportunity to combine commercial leadership, technical expertise and supplier partnership management to shape the future direction of one of Motion's key industrial product categories.

- Manage product range, pricing, promotions, margin performance and Motion Own Brand (PBL) growth.

- Lead supplier negotiations, trading agreements and strategic partnerships to strengthen category performance.

- Develop regional sales plans and identify new products, technologies and market opportunities across APAC.

- Partner with sales, supply chain and marketing to improve inventory, S&OP, customer outcomes and country-level growth.

- Lead product and business development teams, building technical capability through coaching, training and field support.

- Proven commercial results , with experience delivering measurable sales growth, margin improvement, market-share gains and/or inventory improvements.
- Strong supplier-management capability , including leading commercial negotiations, trading agreements, supplier reviews and strategic partnership plans.
- Influential stakeholder-management skills , with the ability to align sales, operations, supply chain, engineering and senior leaders around commercial priorities.
- Technical and customer-focused capability , able to interpret complex application requirements and translate them into practical, value-led product solutions.

jobs.title: Division Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
Division Business Development Manager
SUMMARY:
The Division Business Development Manager is responsible for identifying and converting competitors' business in high/medium opportunity accounts. This role overcomes a long sales cycle that supports penetration of our competitor’s largest accounts.
JOB DUTIES
- Identifies and qualifies customers/prospects who have the potential for significant annual revenue and are focused on a value-based buying culture.
- Aggressively identifies opportunities for disruption, penetration and/or creating new demand.
- Works to break through high opportunity accounts with low current penetration.
- Shifts from competing in the market to making our competition irrelevant through our robust value proposition and the ability to present oneself as a solution provider.
- Identifies and builds strategies to disrupt prospects through the leveraging of our diverse competitive advantages.
- Facilitates and tailors the value proposition offered by Motion to each potential customer.
