jobs.title: Outbound Operations Supervisor Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Job Summary
The Outbound Operations Supervisor is a people leader that drives the successful execution of all pulling and outbound shipping activities. Reporting to the Outbound Operations Manager, this role is responsible for designing efficient and consistent methods for the outbound team(s) to follow, ensuring freight is properly pulled, sorted, packed and loaded in a safe, high quality and timely manner. The Outbound Operations Supervisor ultimately holds their team to a high standard of operational execution, while also reinforcing a culture of engagement, empowerment and problem-solving amongst all teammates.

Responsibilities
- Responsible for supervising and implementing functions of efficient outbound operations by instructing employees how to perform work, monitoring progress and troubleshooting as needed.
- Responsible for designing and maintaining organization of truck yard operations, ensuring efficient organization of trailers, housekeeping, maintenance, and safety protocols are maintained.
- Responsible for consistent and innovative solutions to drive adherence to all security and safety rules and regulations, ensuring a safe environment for employees, including but not limited to picking, sorting and truck load procedures.
- Proactively maintains awareness of budget planning and enforces cost-saving initiatives and process improvements.
- Supervises and provides leadership to warehouse associates, promoting engagement and empowerment to solve problems and make good operational decisions.
- Works with other DC management to investigate and resolve shipping errors; addresses shipping errors with team to mitigate future issues.
- Schedules team hours to ensure peak period coverage and efficiency.
- Protects company assets ensuring all equipment is used and maintained properly, buildings are checked and secured nightly, monitoring employees so no merchandise leaves without proper receipts.
- Responsible for leading efficient and accurate methods of processing outbound orders, cross/docks, stock orders, special orders, UPS, Will Call and any other miscellaneous orders as applicable.
- Identifies opportunities for cost reduction and implements process improvements to enhance operational efficiency.
- Fosters a culture of engagement and empowerment, mentors team members, and facilitates problem-solving and decision-making to drive operational success.
- Oversees the reconciliation of truck loads each night to ensure proper loading of product.
- Responsible for designing and implementing efficient protocols and systems for shuttle truck orders and loading of trucks.
- Ensures team follows all company and supplier guidelines for factory returns.

Qualifications
- High School Diploma, general education degree (GED) or equivalent combination of experience and education.
- 1+ years’ experience within a distribution center or similar environment.
- Ability to comply with all safety requirements pertaining to job functions and general Distribution Center safety requirements.
- Strong interpersonal skills.
- Ability to develop and maintain cooperative working relationships with others.
- Strong organizational skills detail oriented.
- Ability to use good judgment in order to carry out detailed instructions.
- Basic computer skills required.
- Must be capable of lifting/moving heavy items up to 60 lbs.
- Must be forklift and pallet jack certified.

Preferred Qualifications
- 2+ years’ experience within a distribution center or similar environment.
- 1+ year’s proven experience in a managerial role and/or leading teams.
- Experience with Lean Six Sigma methodologies and tools.
- Diverse experience (especially within automotive or retail distribution centers).
- Proven experience performing various quality functions (inspection, control, assurance, audits).
- Proficiency in using relevant tools and technology (including MS Office, Promapp, Power BI, Visio, etc.).
- Customer-centric spirit and task-execution.
- Enthusiasm for data, analysis, and providing simple insights.
- Passion for solving complex challenges.
- Comfort influencing others, leading teams, managing stakeholders, getting buy-in from leadership, and communicating clearly.
- Test-and-learn mentality and agile way of working to improve team products.

Leadership
- Embodies the following values: serve, perform, influence, respect, innovate, team.
- Effectively communicates by motivating and inspiring others through clear and proactive communication.
- Delivers results and drives customer success by committing and focusing on outcomes to deliver results and making the customer the center of decisions.
- Makes balanced decisions and thinks strategically by being a forward thinker.
- Develops high-performing teams by providing inclusive leadership, attracting and developing world-class talent, providing ongoing feedback, and building trust across the organization.

Physical Demands / Working Environment
- Lifting and Carrying: Ability to lift and carry objects of varying weights, typically 25 to 50 pounds or more, depending on the job duties.
- Pushing and Pulling: Capability to push and pull carts, pallet jacks, or other equipment loaded with materials throughout the warehouse. This may involve pushing or pulling heavy loads over extended distances or up ramps.
- Standing and Walking: Willingness and ability to stand and walk for extended periods, often for the duration of a shift. Warehouse employees may be required to move around the warehouse facility to pick orders, stock shelves, or perform other tasks.
- Bending and Stooping: Capacity to bend, stoop, squat, and reach to retrieve items from shelves, bins, or storage racks. Employees may need to access items throughout the warehouse at various heights and angles.
- Climbing: Can climb ladders or stairs to access elevated storage areas or perform maintenance tasks. Warehouse environment will require employees to work at heights to include open floor mezzanines and follow safety protocols for ladder use.
- Operating Equipment: Proficiency in operating warehouse equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, and order pickers. Depending on the job role, employees must pass certification or training programs to operate certain equipment safely.
- Manual Dexterity: Ability to use hands and fingers to handle small objects, operate machinery controls, and perform tasks requiring precision and accuracy. This may include picking and packing items, labeling products, or assembling shipments.
- Repetitive Motion: Willingness and ability to perform repetitive tasks, such as scanning barcodes, sorting items, or packaging products, throughout the shift. Employees should be able to maintain productivity while performing repetitive motions safely.
- Physical Endurance: Stamina and endurance to work in a fast-paced environment and meet productivity targets. Warehouse positions may require employees to work long hours, weekends, or overtime during peak periods.
- Safety Awareness: Commitment to following safety protocols and guidelines to prevent workplace accidents and injuries. Employees should be vigilant about potential hazards in the warehouse environment and take appropriate precautions to ensure their safety and the safety of others.
- Environment : Position operates in a warehouse setting with continuous exposure to industrial noise (e.g., forklifts, conveyors, machinery, and loading activities), bright overhead lighting, and varying temperatures due to limited climate control. Employees regularly work around moving equipment and mechanical operations and must remain alert to audible and visual safety signals in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Motion Industries' is looking for a Strategic Supply Chain Analyst to assume ownership and management for a core group of strategic suppliers.  This includes all related purchasing as well as managing the relationship and overall supplier performance (includes on-time delivery, product quality, negotiating pricing, and master data integrity).  This critical role will help achieve business growth, drive strategic supply chain strategies and efficiently manage key performance indicators.  Motion Industries offers an excellent benefits package which includes options for healthcare coverage, 401(k) plan, tuition reimbursement, vacation, sick, and holiday pay.

Responsibilities:
- Convert supplier requisitions and process purchase orders.  Includes managing and expediting PO’s as well as effectively managing past due PO’s, using the system tools and reports.
- Acquire accurate purchase order and master data information from suppliers.  This may include lead times, MOQ’s, shipping dates, pricing, freight and ETA’s.  Update system information in the purchase order, quote master or vendor master as required.
- Cross train to broaden product knowledge, supplier base and specific process requirements to avoid supply chain interruptions.
- Manage RFQ’s for current product lines as well as special requests from internal departments.  Mentor interdepartmental personnel in best practices in quoting processes.
- Cultivate supplier partnerships to maximize supplier response when issues arise.
- Responsible for negotiating supplier pricing, terms, discounts and rebates.
- Resolve any supplier discrepancies with accounting, inventory control or shipping and coordinate logistics and freight issues with suppliers and receiving department.
- Improve communication around abnormal trends and variations that may affect our supply chain and review slow and non-moving inventories of position’s suppliers.
- Coordinate new product launches and phase outs with marketing and product managers.
- Develop and implement improved methodologies for sourcing long lead time parts.  This will involve managing the procurement of multiple overseas suppliers.
- New supplier sourcing and evaluation to ensure best pricing, quality and performance.
- Review supplier performance including quality, pricing, delivery, quality and any other issues.
- Reconcile supplier returns (MRR and CAR process) to recoup quality issues.
- Visit supplier sites as required and attend supplier on-site meetings.
- Attend work regularly and predictably and uphold Company values in all work aspects.

Qualifications:
- A Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or related business field is required
- 2 years of progressive experience in a manufacturing or distribution environment is preferred.
- Experience in forecasting, inventory management and developing/leading teams is strongly desired
- Ability to handle data-analysis projects and to deal with changing priorities
- Must be able to explain complex functions in simple and understandable language
- Strong reasoning skills including troubleshooting logic flows, drive to produce accurate outputs and excellent written and verbal communications skills
- Requires strong problem solving, project management, data mining and analysis skills
- Knowledge of demand planning and forecasting is preferred.  APICS or other forecasting certification a plus.
- Proficiency in ERP software, advanced proficiency in Microsoft office or SQL language and demonstrated ability and experience with systematic problem solving is highly desired.
- Strong mathematics/statistics aptitude.
- Demonstrated ability and experience with systematic problem solving is highly desired. Ability to communicate clearly and network well with internal and external personnel.
- Job requires the ability to work independently, with moderate to minimal supervision required in unusual situations.
- Ability to work in a fast paced, team environment and handle multiple tasks and stressful situations

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Merchandising/Category
jobs.description:
Job Description
The successful Senior Analyst will provide direct support to the finance team and work with field and headquarters leaders on financial analysis to facilitate decision making. The Senior Analyst will also be responsible for enhancing the design and assist the budgeting and forecasting processes for the US Automotive Parts Group (APG). This includes working with all levels of management to ensure budgeting and forecasting is conducted via a uniform process.

Responsibilities
- Identify and summarize key drivers of financial performance on a consolidated and department level.
- Identify notable trends and variances within the financial results
- Expense management, risk analysis and mitigation.
- Actively monitor expense levers and cost controls required to maintain profitability and achieve budgeted profit targets.
- Interface with Business Leaders to inform strategic inputs to financial models
- Preparation of regular and special budget reports.
- Execute on Ad-Hoc reporting and analysis
- Assist in the creation and development of monthly and quarterly reports
- Provide peer review support on reporting packs to insure accuracy.
- Keep Team Leader/ Department Leader apprised of progress on key work items.
- Be a subject-matter-expertise on TM1 while developing and enhancing its current capabilities to better integrate with the US APG's budgeting and forecasting processes.
- This includes, but is not limited to, defining the integration roll-out of budgeting and forecasting from APG HQ to field operations
- Exploring TMI integration with other financial and business intelligence tools (such as Qlik, OBIEE, COGNOS, etc.) and 3rd party partners (XL Group, RL Fisher, etc.).
- Improve the overall reporting, visualization and comprehension of the budget and forecast.
- Developing and enhancing TM1 training for HQ and field managers.
- Providing monthly support for budgeting and forecasting reports for all levels of US APG management.
-

Qualifications
- Minimum of 2 years' prior work experience in Corporate Reporting/FP&A role 5+ years preferred.
- Advanced knowledge of TM1 or other budgeting and forecasting tools, such as Hyperion (as an administrator)
- Good understanding of US GAAP
- Highest standards of accuracy and precision highly organized.
- Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (emphasis on Excel and PowerPoint)
- Balance multiple priorities, work independently and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
- Articulate with excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Excellent problem solving capabilities and superior analytical skills
- Highly motivated, passionate, self-starter comfortable interacting with senior management
- Strong business acumen with understanding of functional linkages and ability to build strong professional relationships with business partners in both operational and financial roles
- Demonstrate flexibility in approach and follow up
- Demonstrated ability to develop constructive and cooperative working relationships with others, and maintaining them over time.
- Ability to work flexible schedule
- Experience using complex databases, spreadsheets and presentation software tools for budgeting and financial analysis.
- Experience creating business solutions backed by data and analysis.
- Undergraduate degree from an accredited institution (or other advanced degree in economics, mathematics, finance, marketing intelligence or business intelligence) or equivalent. MBA preferred.
- High level of commercial and financial acumen experience required.
- Demonstrated and advanced proficiency with business intelligence tools.
- Work is performed in a typical office environment.

jobs.title: Head of Sales - STEDI Truganina
jobs.description:
Ready to light up the market?

An exciting opportunity has become available for an experienced, commercially driven Head of Sales to lead the next stage of growth for STEDI .

A leader in automotive parts and accessories, STEDI is the fastest-growing auxiliary lighting brand in the market. Based at our modern Truganina headquarters, you’ll lead the development and delivery of sales strategies across local and global markets.

The Role
We’re looking for an energetic, commercially savvy Head of Sales to lead growth across our automotive and 4WD lighting solutions range. From everyday driving to off-road adventures, you’ll help put quality lighting products where they belong, out in the market and performing when it matters

Your key responsibilities include:
- Develop strategic sales plans that support business objectives and market growth.

- Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer needs to uncover opportunities.

- Build and grow reseller, wholesale, key account, and OE sales channels.

- Lead sales reporting, KPIs, forecasting, and performance metrics to drive sales and margin growth.

- Develop strong customer value propositions and programs for each sales channel.

- Build lasting relationships with wholesale and retail partners.

- Collaborate with internal teams to deliver outstanding customer experiences.

- Lead, coach, and motivate a high-performing sales and support team.

- Deliver sales targets in line with channel budgets.

About You
You’re a strategic and energetic sales leader with a passion for growth, strong customer relationships, and getting results. You can comfortably move between big-picture planning and rolling up your sleeves to make things happen.

To succeed, you’ll bring:
- Experience in wholesale, key account, and channel sales planning and execution.

- A proven record of delivering revenue growth across consumer and commercial markets.

- Strong leadership experience, with the ability to build and inspire capable teams.

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

- An analytical mindset and confidence using data to guide decisions.

- Enterprise-level experience and industry contacts that can support new business development.

- A collaborative, positive, and customer-focused approach.

- A genuine drive for continuous improvement and personal development.

- Strong attention to detail and creative problem-solving skills.

- A passion for automotive, 4WD, and the aftermarket industry.

Why Join STEDI?
- Be part of a modern, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

- Work-life balance with great hours and an energetic team culture.

- Opportunities for growth, career development, and recognition for your contributions.

- Be part of a market-leading, innovative, and trusted brand.

- Attractive remuneration based on experience.

- Career Growth: Pathways for professional development and internal promotion.

- Team Culture: Work alongside passionate, fun, like-minded individuals.

- Modern Facilities: Our headquarters in Truganina offers a state-of-the-art work environment.

- Stability: A secure position with a trusted employer in a growing industry.

- Staff discounts across the GPC Asia Pacific group of Companies

- Private health insurance discounts

- Employee assistance program

- A highly safety conscious work environment

About STEDI
STEDI is a premier provider of high-quality automotive lighting and accessories, dedicated to reshaping the industry through innovation, reliability, and exceptional service. Our products are crafted for 4WD enthusiasts, off-roaders, and outdoor adventurers across Australia who expect nothing less than premium performance and durability.

For more information about STEDI please visit www.stedi.com.au

jobs.description:
Financial Analyst - Payroll
Job Summary

Responsibilities
- Prepare manual checks as required and balances bank deposits. Reconciles ACH debits/credits.
- Prepare Insurance, ESC Vendor Bills, Retiree and Cobra Billing Statements, manual bills, and payment posting and Employee/Employer breakdown by vendor.
- Prepare journal entries as necessary for banking transactions, corrections, and Month End JE’s.
- Respond efficiently and effectively to all correspondence from field customers, employees or 3rd party vendors via phone, email and/or to employee and business partner inquiries through Service Now Case Management System, delivering exceptional customer service.
- Work on special projects as assigned including recovering ACH funds not refunded, account reconciliations, accruals, and journal entries as well as cross train with other team members. Processes weekly ADP Payroll JE’s.

- Newport Deferrals and Employee Stock Purchase Program.
- Submit Direct Deposit File, Credit Union, HSA (Banking Files), Emergency Relief Fund Funding and Your Cause funding.
- Handle Wire & ACH File transfers (401k, ADP Payroll tax, Deferrals, ESPP).
- Record and reports paid ACH’s and Manual Checks.
- Act as liaison in budget/forecasting process for payroll department expenses.

jobs.title: Intl Trade Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
SUMMARY:

The Trade Compliance Analyst II provides support and guidance to the Global Sourcing group and Motion business units to ensure compliance with all applicable government laws and regulations in the company’s international trade activities. This position serves as a liaison between the business units and US and Canada government agencies, acts as subject matter expert for all trade issues involving product regulatory oversight, and ensures all import and export transactions comply with the laws and regulations of the US and Canada. This position is also responsible for ensuring international shipments conform to business agreements, including freight charges, service levels, and service provider performance. This position requires coordination with multiple groups within Motion, including legal, finance, audit, IT, and other relevant departments for process development, compliance evaluations, and training/awareness.

JOB DUTIES
- Supports US and Canada branch locations with international trade related activities.
- Researches and assesses applicability of US and CA regulations for business units, concerning forced labor laws, C-TPAT, FDA, EPA, etc.
- Works with the Global Sourcing Office and subsidiary procurement teams to ensure product safety compliance at the sourcing as well as procurement and importation stages.
- Ensures that products and processes comply with local, state/provincial, and federal requirements.
- Assists with development, implementation, and maintenance of import and export compliance policies, procedures, manuals, and work instructions.
- Responds to classification inquiries from the business units, customs brokers, and government agencies. Researches and provides necessary information for import entries.
- Provides direction related to ADD/CVD, tariffs, rules of origin, product marking, and qualification of Free Trade Agreements.
- Conducts entry audits and supports the monitoring and retention of records and documentation for import and export shipments.
- Interfaces with internal and external customers, freight forwarders, customs officers, and other functional areas to ensure coordination and compliance of shipments.
- Coordinates with freight forwarders to schedule shipments to meet customer demand.
- Creates and performs training as needed on impact of logistical and regulatory matters to the organization.
- Conducts vettings of international customers to ensure corporate export compliance. Interprets and applies US and Canada export controls.
- Performs other duties as required.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE
- Typically requires a bachelor's degree and three (3) to five (5) years of related experience or an equivalent combination.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES
- Excellent project management skills and detail oriented. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Having strong collaboration skills and able to influence without authority is required.
- Strong organizational skills.
- Practical subject matter experience in product safety regulations including Prop 65, hazard communication (SDS, OSHA, WHMIS, GHS, etc.), transport regulations (DOT, IMDG, IATA), and other applicable product regulations (TSCA, VOC, FIFRA, SARA, CPSC, etc.).
- Experience with complex organizational supply chains and systems preferred.
- Self-motivated, with ability to set and achieve goals, and ability to prioritize multiple tasks in order to meet deadlines.
- Experience with Microsoft Office applications required. Database and spreadsheet experience preferred.
- Ability to learn and utilize various types of software and information systems.
- Bilingual is a plus.
- Familiar with US Code of Federal Regulations, ACE Portal, CROSS, US HTS, US Export Rules and Regulations (ECCN, ITAR, Restricted Party Screening). Knowledge of US Customs and government regulations, government agencies, and product regulations

LICENSES & CERTIFICATIONS: None required.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

BUDGET RESPONSIBILITY: No

Motion Industries offers an excellent benefits package which includes options for healthcare coverage, 401(k), tuition, reimbursement, vacation, sick, and holiday pay.

- Leads a team of five or more shop employees performing skilled trades, lower level apprentice craft work, and operation of machines used in production processes. Typically has budget and hire/fire authority.
- Develops and implements production schedules to ensure the effective use of labor, tools, and equipment; operating.
- Provides coaching and feedback to shop employees.
- Assigns and coordinates tasks based on workload.
- Monitors performance metrics and allocates resources as necessary to ensure high quality service at optimal efficiency.
- Ensures that processes and environmental conditions comply with local and national regulatory agencies, and the organization's safety standards.
- Responsible for the installation, diagnostics, repair and support for products that are installed and operating at customers' location.
- Maintains and promotes ISO and Motion Quality System as well as the Safety and Loss Prevention program.
- Maintains a positive rapport with vendors, branch personnel and Motion specialists.
- Evaluates, checks, and signs all completed items that leave the shop facility.
- Performs other duties as assigned.

Typically requires a high school diploma or GED and ten (10) or more years of related experience or an equivalent combination.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Ability to manage, motivate and handle multitude of priorities daily.
- Must be able to operate shop equipment safely.
- Knowledge of various metals and measurements used in machining processes required.
- Knowledge of machinist, CAD and/or CAM software required.
- Knowledge of mathematics and its application required.
- Knowledge of raw materials, production processes, quality control, costs and other techniques for maximizing the effective manufacture and distribution of goods required.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.location: GBR AAG - NAPA Auto Parts Norwich | NORW
jobs.description:
NAPA Auto Parts was founded in 1925 to meet America’s need for an effective automotive parts distribution system. In the century since, NAPA has exploded across the globe, carrying a reputation of quality and excellence with it. Distributed by Alliance Automotive Group (AAG) in the United Kingdom, NAPA has become a market-leading parts brand in the country with a championship-winning motorsport team. Now, over 275 AAG UK subsidiaries are unifying under the NAPA Auto Parts name, joining the largest network of motor factors in the world. The prestigious NAPA Auto Parts family boasts a staggering 6,000+ locations across the US, Canada, and Australia — and now the United Kingdom.

We are currently looking for a Business Development Manager (BDM).

As the BDM, you are specifically accountable for delivering sales and margin growth for your customer base. The successful candidate will be responsible for building and maintaining strong customer relationships within their targeted territory.

Responsibilities:

- Confident in building sales strategies and tactics within your required territory

- Proven ability to communicate effectively with Branch, Regional and Senior Management

- Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, field-based trainers, and product managers.

- Effectively analyse business intelligence software

- Able to influence the branch management and sales team.

To be successful in this role:

The successful candidate must have a customer focused approach with excellent selling skills, combined with the ability to communicate to all customer groups building strong relationships across the region.

- Dynamic and performance-oriented individual with strong negotiation and selling skills.

- Commercial awareness and good knowledge of competitor activity and market conditions is a must.

- Extensive experience with customer account management

- Previous experience delivering sales and margin growth within a business-to-business environment.

- Experience at finding and developing new business.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Strong training and presentation skills

- Work well under pressure towards deadlines.

In return we offer:

- An opportunity to join a global brand and market leader.

- Exclusive discounts and cashback from 1000s of major retailers and grocers via the AAG Benefits App, including Tesco, Boots and Just Eat.

- Opportunities for career progression and bespoke training.

- Free pension advice from our standard pension provider.

- Free access to Health, Wellbeing and Financial tools.

- Potential to earn a performance based bonus, paid monthly.

- Discount on car parts

Other Details:

- Company Car

- Mobile Phone

Alliance Automotive Group is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.description:
Cybersecurity Analyst Intern Job Description

Ready for a challenging and rewarding internship? This is your opportunity to work hands-on with security teams throughout the summer and help protect our critical infrastructure and data! Join a leading Industrial Distribution company and unleash your cybersecurity skills to safeguard our business operations!

We share a mindset at Motion Industries where we're using our security expertise to protect our business. If you're ready to unleash your knowledge, manage risk around cyber threats, and bust out of the ordinary, find out what's next at Motion Industries.

This position will be based in Birmingham, AL. The ideal candidates will reside in the Birmingham, AL area.

Responsibilities

- Participate in security status meetings and provide reports to Security Managers

- Work with Security Architects to develop and implement security solutions

- Monitor security systems and analyze security events, logs, and alerts

- Assist in vulnerability assessments and penetration testing activities

- Document security incidents, findings, and remediation procedures

- Work with IT teams to deploy security controls and monitor system configurations

- Support security compliance initiatives and audit processes

- Investigate potential security incidents and escalate threats appropriately

Qualifications

- Working on a BS or BA degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, or related field

- Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, VPNs)

- Working knowledge of security tools (SIEM, IDS/IPS, vulnerability scanners)

- Familiarity with security frameworks (NIST, CIS Controls, OWASP) a plus

- Basic understanding of Linux and Windows system security

- Familiarity with common attack vectors and defensive security practices

- High-level understanding of security lifecycle and incident response

- Ability to work within a team

- Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written)

- Must be self-motivated and know when to seek guidance

- Individual must be a self-starter and capable of working independently as well as part of a team

- Capable of learning new security tools and technologies

- Ability to provide strong problem-solving skills using a variety of analytical methods

- Strong attention to detail and ability to identify anomalies

jobs.title: District Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary
The role of the District Manager, Sales is to drive sales thru the Sales Pro team to grow commercial sales and overall NAPA Commercial Value Proposition. The leader is responsible for ensuring the Sales Pro team understanding of and selling of NAPA programs to all assigned customers. Communicates monthly wholesale strategies and tactics to the Sales Pros, assigning goals and holding the sellers accountable. This role is responsible for building high performing teams and ensuring NAPAs vision, values, and culture exceed expectations for employees, customers, and key stakeholders to drive NAPA’s profitability.

Responsibilities
- Leads and motivates Sales Pro team to achieve and exceed sales quota of assigned accounts by leveraging NAPA Wholesale promotions, programs, and initiatives with purchases of NAPA Auto Parts and services through: - Consistent and effective presentations to assigned accounts.
- Leveraging the NAPA Auto Care Program(s)
- Major Account, Fleet and Government program sales
- All aspects of customer connectivity: NAPA PROLink, TRACS, etc.
- Lead NAPA AutoTech Training Classes
- Identify IBS prospects

- Ensures HQ directed sales programs and initiatives are executed at a high level to drive growth and profitability.
- Leads, motivates, and mentors Sales Pro team to implement effective sales strategies to achieve revenue targets and market share growth across all locations.

- Analyzes market trends to identify opportunities for gross margin expansion and ongoing pricing maintenance. Collaborates with operation leadership in preparing business cases for investment at store level.
- Track sales metrics and KPIs, preparing reports and presentations for senior management to communicate progress and identify areas for improvement.
- Manage Sales Pro team prospecting of new accounts and/or fostering growth of underperformers. Ensures proper registration of all assigned accounts in RAM.

- Build and maintain relationships with effective communication with store teams, customers, and executive leadership thru collaboration and influence to achieve success through others.

- Partners with store leadership to identify and deploy strategies and tools to improve store efficiency and service levels to achieve and exceed district financial objectives and quotas.
- Oversee unmanageable debt collections and ensure expenses to remain within established budgets.
- Build and maintain relationships with effective communication with store teams, customers, and executive leadership thru collaboration and influence to achieve success through others.
- Demonstrates sound decision-making ensuring adherence to company values and policies; requires and models high levels of professionalism of self and teams.
- Ensures team maintains a safe and healthy environment for customers and employees. Complies with all applicable policies, rules, and regulations, including those relating to safety, health, labor, and employment.

- Utilizes NAPA CRM Tools to monitor leads, log customer interactions and schedule sales calls.

Key Performance Indicators
- Sales Quota attainment.
- Gross Margin/Profit Expansion and Quota attainment.
- Execution of company sales programs and initiatives.
- Sales Team averages ten presentations a day.
- AutoCare Center Sales and membership growth.

- Excellent results-oriented management skills, multi-tasking and time management capabilities, exceptional team leadership abilities, and a strong work ethic.
- Demonstrated strong interpersonal and leadership skills including a willingness to consistently provide superior customer service, the ability to react appropriately under pressure, the ability to apply good judgment in ambiguous situations.
- Strong analytical/critical thinking skills and demonstrates adaptability by adjusting to changing business priorities.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with the ability to synthesize detailed information into succinct and actionable recommendations.
- Initiative-taking, deliverable-focused, strong work ethic, able to prioritize and resolve an array of issues simultaneously. Works with a sense of urgency.
- Demonstrates high-level of ethical behavior in exercising judgement and discretion in matters of significance.
- Capable of driving change transformation and strategy execution to achieve specific business results.
- Collaborative mindset and ability to navigate and build trust in a complex organization.
- Ability to inspire a shared vision, empower, and motivate a team and as needed, do this from afar.
- Ability to work the business hours within the territory or region to address customer needs and support growth of sales.

Competencies
- Sales Acumen: The ability to understand and apply sales principles, techniques, and processes effectively.

jobs.title: Autotech Regional Manager, Sales & Business Development
jobs.description:
Job Summary
The Region Manager, NAPA Autotech Sales & Business Development leads field execution and regional growth of NAPA Autotech training programs. This role directly manages assigned instructors; ensures high-quality, customer-focused training delivery; and is accountable for regional training sales, profit, utilization, customer satisfaction, and operating results.

The Region Manager partners with NAPA field leadership, distribution centers, Major and Regional Accounts, System Sales, suppliers, and Autotech leadership to identify demand, build training commitments, expand participation, and strengthen the NAPA Autotech brand. The role balances customer requirements, instructor capacity, travel, expenses, safety, and training quality across an assigned territory.

Responsibilities

Regional Growth and Financial Performance

- Execute the regional Autotech operating and growth plan to achieve assigned sales, profit, training-volume, and customer-engagement objectives.
- Analyze regional sales, class, utilization, expense, and customer data; identify gaps and implement actions to improve results.
- Promote Autotech training programs to field leaders, customers, Major Accounts, Regional Accounts, suppliers, and other stakeholders to secure class commitments and attendance.
- Identify and develop new customer, market, sponsorship, and training-growth opportunities.
- Execute approved class and online pricing programs; escalate requested exceptions through the appropriate leadership channels.
- Support training initiatives that strengthen customer automotive and truck repair knowledge, diagnostic capability, service-sales effectiveness, and related parts-sales opportunities.

Training Operations and Customer Experience

- Lead efficient regional execution of instructor-led and applicable digital training programs in accordance with approved plans, budgets, policies, and customer requirements.
- Assess customer needs and allocate instructor, equipment, training-aid, and material resources to meet demand while optimizing quality, utilization, cost, and travel efficiency.
- Review, assign, and approve instructor schedules; monitor training days, customer coverage, class attendance, travel, and expense performance.
- Ensure training materials and demonstration aids are available and appropriately distributed for scheduled programs.
- Coordinate the transportation and setup of training aids, including mockups, as needed to support training delivery.
- Address customer concerns, training-delivery issues, and operational barriers promptly and professionally.
- Monitor competitor offerings and customer feedback to recommend regional improvements to programs, delivery methods, and market approach.

People Leadership and Talent Development

- Lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable assigned instructors.
- Manage recruitment, selection, onboarding, deployment, engagement, performance management, retention, and succession activities for assigned instructors.
- Establish clear performance expectations for instructional quality, customer experience, safety, utilization, communication, and operating results.
- Observe and evaluate instructor performance; provide timely feedback, coaching, recognition, development plans, and corrective action, as appropriate.
- Foster a respectful, inclusive, safe, collaborative, and customer-focused work environment.
- Communicate Autotech priorities, goals, quotas, policies, initiatives, and performance results consistently to the instructor team.

Partnerships and Communication

- Serve as the primary regional liaison among Autotech, NAPA field and headquarters teams, distribution center leadership, Major Account leaders, System Sales, suppliers, and customers.
- Maintain regular contact with regional decision-makers and provide timely updates on training opportunities, schedules, results, issues, and customer needs.
- Partner with field and headquarters teams on marketing, communications, and promotional activities that increase class commitments, attendance, and customer adoption.
- Present Autotech offerings at NAPA meetings, customer meetings, distribution-center meetings, conferences, trade shows, tool shows, owner meetings, and other promotional events.
- Communicate Major Account training plans and progress to the appropriate account-management stakeholders.
- Provide clear written communications, reports, presentation materials, and virtual sessions that keep field teams informed of Autotech programs and results.

Governance, Safety and Continuous Improvement

- Manage regional operating expenses, travel, inventory, vehicles, training equipment, and other assigned assets in accordance with budget and company policy.
- Ensure assigned vehicles, training aids, and equipment are maintained in safe working conditions and used in accordance with applicable safety requirements.
- Enforce company policies, standard operating procedures, pricing practices, safety requirements, and asset-control standards.
- Recommend and implement process improvements that improve productivity, instructor utilization, training quality, customer experience, and regional financial performance.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

- High school diploma or equivalent.
- 5+ years of experience as a working automotive technician.
- 5+ years of progressive leadership, sales, training, shop-operations, marketing, curriculum-development, or comparable business experience, including experience coaching, managing, or developing others.
- Demonstrated ability to sell, promote, or grow service-based or other intangible programs.
- Knowledge of automotive and/or truck repair operations, shop functions, diagnostic processes, automotive systems, and industry terminology.
- Experience leading teams, managing performance, and fostering employee engagement in a field-based or geographically dispersed environment.
- Strong business acumen and ability to interpret sales, profit, utilization, expense, and operating data to guide decisions.
- Strong customer relationship, communication, presentation, planning, organization, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to prioritize multiple demands, exercise sound judgment, manage change, and execute with urgency.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
- Ability to travel extensively—up to 80%—by vehicle and commercial air, including overnight, weekend, and holiday travel as business needs require.
- Demonstrated integrity and commitment to a safe, respectful workplace.

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in business, automotive technology, education, operations, or a related field.
- Experience in automotive technical training, technician development, aftermarket operations, or repair-shop management.
- Experience directly supervising automotive technical instructors or other field-based technical teams.
- Experience supporting Major Accounts, Regional Accounts, multi-location customers, franchise systems, or field-sales organizations.
- Knowledge of NAPA programs, operations, customers, and field structure.
- Working knowledge of repair-information systems, including Mitchell 1 or comparable platforms.
- ASE Master Automobile Technician certification and/or ASE Advanced Engine Performance Specialist (L1) certification.
- EPA Section 609 Refrigerant Handling certification.
- Experience using learning-management systems, virtual-training platforms, customer-relationship-management systems, or performance-reporting tools.

Leadership

- Embodies the following values: serve, perform, influence, respect, innovate, team.
- Effectively communicates by motivating and inspiring others through clear and proactive communication.
- Delivers results and drives customer success by committing and focusing on outcomes to deliver results and making the customer the center of decisions.
- Makes balanced decisions and thinks strategically by being a forward thinker.
- Develops high-performing teams by providing inclusive leadership, attracting and developing world-class talent, providing ongoing feedback, and building trust across the organization.

Physical Demands / Working Environment

- Frequently communicate verbally and in writing with instructors, customers, field leaders, suppliers, and business partners; regularly present to small and large groups in person and virtually.
- Frequently use a computer, telephone, mobile device, and standard office equipment.
- Regularly remain stationary during office work, travel, meetings, training observations, and presentations.
- Frequently move within offices, training facilities, customer shops, distribution centers, conference venues, trade shows, and event sites.
- Travel extensively—up to 80%—by vehicle and commercial air, including overnight travel and occasional weekend or holiday travel.
- Regularly load, unload, transport, arrange, and set up training materials, demonstration aids, mockups, and related equipment.
- Occasionally inspect vehicles, training equipment, customer shop environments, and training locations; this may require standing, walking, bending, reaching, climbing stairs, and working around typical automotive-service activity.
- Occasionally lift, carry, push, pull, or move training aids and materials weighing up to 100 pounds.
- Work in office, classroom, training-center, customer-shop, warehouse, and event environments, which may involve exposure to noise, vehicle/equipment activity, fumes, and varying temperatures.

jobs.title: Group Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Alliance Automotive Group (AAG) is a leading distributor of passenger and commercial vehicle parts to the independent automotive aftermarket in Europe. It operates in France, the U.K., Ireland, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, Portugal, Poland, Hungary and Romania. The company is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Genuine Parts Company (GPC), the largest global automotive replacement parts distributor with activities in North America, Europe, and Australasia. AAG’s network serves thousands of customers across Europe supported by a logistics infrastructure of 75 Distribution Centres, approximately 2,550 Stores and thousands of vehicle repairers, body shops and auto-centres. AAG has a revenue of 3.4 billion euros with over 17,000 employees. Learn more at www.allianceautomotivegroup.eu

About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Group Marketing Manager to lead our entire marketing function across multiple business units. This senior leadership role involves managing a large, multidisciplinary marketing team of around 25 people, spanning B2B and B2C marketing, digital marketing, private label, and creative support functions including graphic design. The role also includes oversight of marketing activities for our BTCC racing team.

Our organisation operates through multiple business units, managing numerous brands and selling through a variety of channels, including a robust distribution network and a significant store network across the UK and Ireland. The successful candidate will have extensive experience in managing marketing strategies across diverse brands, selling channels, and marketing platforms, ensuring alignment and growth across all areas.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and manage the comprehensive marketing function covering multiple business units and brands.

- Manage and develop a diverse marketing team of approximately 25 people, including specialists in product marketing, digital, private label, creative support, and more.

- Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies that address the needs of different brands, selling channels (B2B, B2C, retail, distribution), and marketing platforms.

- Oversee the marketing and positioning of private label products to maximise market share and brand strength.

- Coordinate marketing efforts related to the BTCC racing team, leveraging this platform for brand visibility and engagement.

- Ensure marketing strategies support and drive growth across the UK and Ireland distribution and store networks.

- Collaborate closely with commercial leaders and senior management to ensure marketing initiatives are aligned with broader business objectives.

- Manage the marketing budget responsibly to maximise return on investment.

- Analyse market trends, customer insights, and competitive activity across multiple sectors, brands, and channels to continuously refine marketing approaches.

- Report directly to the Managing Director of UK Subsidiaries, providing clear and insightful updates on marketing performance and strategic direction.

Essential Experience

- Proven track record managing large marketing teams (circa 25 people) and owning whole marketing functions.

- Experience managing marketing across multiple business units and brands.

- Experience leading marketing efforts across differing selling channels including B2B, B2C, retail, and distribution
-
- .
- Extensive digital marketing expertise covering a range of platforms and channels.

- Experience managing private label marketing strategies.

- Experience working with creative teams including graphic design as part of a broader marketing function.

- Proven experience managing sponsorship or sports marketing programmes, ideally motorsport or similar high-profile partnerships.

- Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

- Demonstrable commercial acumen and ability to develop marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.

- Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field preferred.

Personal Attributes

- Strategic and operational thinker capable of hands-on delivery.

- Collaborative and influential leader.

- Highly organised and comfortable managing complex, multi-brand, multi-channel marketing environments.

- Committed to driving marketing excellence and team development.

jobs.title: Store Operations Analyst (US - Remote)
jobs.description:
Analyst, Store Operations
Job Summary
We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Store Operations Analyst to join our dynamic auto parts team. The primary focus of this role is the review and analysis of various metrics including: RGNs, Core Accounts, Bad Debt, Store Billings, Cycle Counts, Pcard usage and Cash variances to manage the reconciliation activities Additionally, the Store Operations Analyst will present field leadership with actionable information about these metrics and collaborate closely with Loss Prevention and Operations teams in identifying operational and compliance opportunities, and developing plans of resolution. If you are passionate about cars, trucks, motorcycles, and all things automotive, and are eager to learn and grow, this position is perfect for you!
Responsibilities
- Review all store operations databases to ensure accuracy of reported information.
- Submit daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliation items as per company policies and procedures.
- Partner with field teams to assess aged and ageing RGN trends, investigate cause of RGN discrepancies, and provide weekly updates on resolved and outstanding issues related RGNs and credit flow.
- Partner with distribution centers, vendors, and the NAPA DCSC team to investigate cause of credit discrepancies.
- Review data and trend analysis of AR accounts listed as bad debt to aid field teams in collection and root cause analysis including Core Account management.
- Review Company Pcard activity to ensure compliance in the field with reconciliation at the store level and to identify anomalies to be investigated by the Loss Prevention Team.
- Report identified anomalies to the loss prevention team.
- Review cash handling metrics to identify procedural issues with store deposits, collection from COD customers and daily over and short activity within the stores.
- Provide feedback and guidance related to the evolution of the analyst role as NAPA adapts to the onboarding of enhanced store and supply chain systems and controls.

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent work experience and High School Diploma required.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- At least five years of relevant analytical work experience; NAPA store experience is a plus.
- Basic understanding of accounting principles.
- Proficient in computer skills, especially Excel.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and remain calm under pressure.
- Strong analytical problem-solving skills, multitasking abilities, and attention to detail.

Physical Demands / Working Environment
- Office working environment.
